summary: M5 Phase 2: Editor & UX Enhancement — word count, focus mode, AI inline actions, keyboard navigation, responsive layout, live metrics
approach: Three-wave parallel execution. Wave 1: independent feature implementations (word count, focus mode, AI toolbar). Wave 2: cross-cutting polish (keyboard nav + ARIA, responsive + metrics). Wave 3: regression test suite covering all Phase 2 features.

data_flow.diagram: NikoEditor.onUpdate → wordStats → AppContextFooter + SessionAnalytics | uiSlice.focusMode → layout components | editorAIPromptPolicy → BubbleToolbar

design_decisions.rationale: Global layout state needs cross-component access
TipTap CharacterCount extension provides built-in stats
Reuses existing AI pipeline in editorAIPromptPolicy

patterns: Zustand slice pattern: create*Slice function returning StateCreator
TipTap extension config in useEditor extensions array
AI actions via useEditorAI hook + editorAIPromptPolicy
